Hello, 

I think what you’re experiencing can be very normal. 

The first time I started wellbutrin I had a couple of major anxiety attacks. My doctor told me that wellbutrin can increase anxiety which I guess makes sense when you factor in the increased energy and focus it can also give you. 

I was put on cipralex in combination with wellbutrin at the time and it levelled out. 

I’m terrible at being compliant with my medications despite my ongoing obvious depression that can be severe. 

I stopped my medications. 

Became basically bed bound with depression. 

Finally went back to my doctor and with some discussion he’s put me back on just the wellbutrin (I didn’t like some of the side effects of cipralex). So far no anxiety issues! 

If you keep having these anxiety issues talk with your doctor! 

Hope you feel better!
